verdict.rationale: Mem0 documents a Memory Export feature that creates structured exports of memories using customizable Pydantic schemas, and its CLI can list memories. The open-source engine, the same engine as the Platform, lets users own the stack and data, which gives a credible path to leave the hosted service. However, the evidence never confirms that the export covers all account data (for example graph relations, metadata, or audit logs) or names an open file format, so the story is only partly met. Missing for 10: explicit full-account bulk export, a documented open output format (e.g. JSON/CSV), Platform-to-self-host migration or account-deletion guidance, and independent hands-on corroboration of export.
